copy.lede: Lauren is a painter and decorator around Sherborne. Customers talk about her eye for detail, slick clean lines and help choosing colours, and plenty of them have her back for the next room.
copy.about_alt: A cottage sitting room with an inglenook fireplace, decorated by Lauren

steps.title: Before
steps.text: Patchy, stained walls and old paper half off.

steps.title: After
steps.text: Prepped, filled and painted. The same bedroom.

steps.title: Before
steps.text: Old wallpaper stripped back to patchy walls.

steps.text: Walls made good and finished in a deep green. Same room again.
